turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hello, Leander. I can help you find your print. To verify your account, please send me the order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I'm sorry, Leander, but I can't look up orders by name. To find your order, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address it was placed with. You can usually find the order number in your order confirmation email, and the email is the one you used at checkout. Once I have both, I can share the status and tracking link.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, Leander, but I can't share any order details, including the delivery address or shipping status, until I can verify the order. To do that, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address it was placed with. If you can find the order number in your confirmation email, I can check it for you.
